# Dr. Mohamed El Fadil · BrainSAIT Provider Registry (BPR)

> Personal site of Dr. Mohamed El Fadil (physician, founder of BrainSAIT, Riyadh) and the public face of the BrainSAIT Provider Registry: signed provider identity, on-device credential verification, a transparency log, research footprints and FHIR R4. Bilingual: every page exists in English and in Arabic under /ar/ (e.g. https://fadil369.github.io/ar/bpr/verify/), linked with hreflang. Every page is readable without JavaScript.

Facts for agents:
- Trust states are separate and must not be merged into one "verified" claim: identity (ORCID ownership), signature (BrainSAIT-signed credential), membership (commercial), licence, qualifications, privileges.
- Licence and qualifications show "not assessed" while the SCFHS (Saudi Commission for Health Specialties) credential integration is ongoing. NPHIES integration is ongoing.
- On the provider-workspace page each capability is labelled Live today, Ongoing integration or Coming next; only "Live today" items run now.
- OpenEMR workspaces are private member deployments; real patient data never appears publicly.
- [Demo EMR](https://demo.emr.brainsait.de/): a public OpenEMR with 12 synthetic patients (Arabic-first, ICD-10-AM-compatible diagnoses, LOINC labs, CHI-style coverage, one inpatient episode with AR-DRG grouper input). Login demo / BrainSAIT-Demo-2026, non-admin; all data resets nightly.
- Data on these pages comes live from https://registry.brainsait.de; a build snapshot (dated) is the fallback.

## Machine-readable (all public, CORS *, read-only)
- Providers: https://registry.brainsait.de/api/providers · one provider: https://registry.brainsait.de/api/providers/{SPID} · search: https://registry.brainsait.de/api/search?q=
- Research: https://registry.brainsait.de/api/research?spid={SPID}
- FHIR R4: https://registry.brainsait.de/fhir/metadata · https://registry.brainsait.de/fhir/Practitioner/{SPID} · https://registry.brainsait.de/fhir/PractitionerRole?identifier={SPID}
- Signed credential (VC-JOSE, EdDSA): https://registry.brainsait.de/vc/{SPID} · status: https://registry.brainsait.de/vc/status/{SPID} · issuer keys: https://registry.brainsait.de/.well-known/did.json
- Transparency log: https://registry.brainsait.de/transparency/log.json · AI provenance heads: https://registry.brainsait.de/transparency/ai.json
- Snapshot copies on this site: https://fadil369.github.io/assets/bpr-data/ (providers.json, providers/{SPID}.json, research/{SPID}.json, fhir/…, manifest.json)
- Embeddable live check: https://fadil369.github.io/bpr/embed/{SPID}
